name: XWF Anniversary 2003

date.source: Named by C.R. on Primetime Central's own New Era of 20 April 2003, in the past tense.

evidence.note: C.R., cutting a promo before his own title defence: "At XWF Anniversary 2003 it was brought to my attention that a lot of people probably don't want me here."

notes: Known to have run before 20 April 2003; not held.

name: XWF Payback

date.source: Announced from Primetime Central's own announce desk on 20 April 2003 as an upcoming XWF card.

evidence.note: The New Era commentary, setting up the next XWF card: "C.R. may have won the match but believe me The Corporation is making him work hard and he won't be 100% for Payback when he faces Asesino."

notes: Announced; nothing held says whether it ran.
